title: Soup after the Dance
story: After the harvest dance, people gathered in the hall for soup. Mina carried bowls from the kitchen while her cousin cut bread. An older neighbour told a story about the first dance there. Everyone listened, then clapped. Mina tried the soup and added a little pepper. She sat with her cousin and learned the steps she had missed. They agreed to practise before the next dance.

vocabulary.definition: The time when crops are gathered.
Hit their hands together to show pleasure.
A spice with a sharp taste.
